normalization: No NFC, whitespace edit, character substitution, Alef/hamza/ya/ta mapping, vowel removal, stemming or stopword removal
primary_comparator: simple baseline with highest perturbed Macro-F1 on primary cohort; ties use TAT then REP2 then NO_CONTEXT
primary_decision: Support only if NASN2 paired perturbed Macro-F1 gain over every simple baseline has CI lower bound >0 and clean Macro-F1 difference is nonnegative. Semantic certification and independent-review provenance are separately required. Otherwise recommend abandoning the improvement claim or reframing as a conservative preprocessing audit; do not add post-hoc rules.
annotation_independence: unverified; no new independent-human agreement estimate permitted
